data_fields.name: local_view_radius_max_cells
data_fields.donor_constant: viewing distance / 8192, clamped to [1, max setting]

best_idea: Reveal the map as a monotone, radial, min-merged soft circle around the player so exploration never un-hides and the cost is one small texture pass per frame.
decision_why: Take the min-merge radial reveal and explored threshold for a client minimap (HUD is client-only); drop the 3 x 3 tiling unless zones tile the same way; keep reveal state out of any second ledger.
acceptance: A player walks into a new zone and sees a soft circle of the minimap light up around them; a headless test asserts no texel goes from explored back to unexplored along a fixed path and that the player's own texel reads explored.
